# Dot Products

Multiply corresponding coordinates and add the products. For coefficients $(b,w)$ and input $(1,x)$ the result is $b+wx$.

## Worked example

$$
(1, 4) \cdot (3, 2) = 1 \times 3 + 4 \times 2 = 11.
$$

## Prerequisites

- [[Vectors]]

## Exercises

1. Calculate the dot product when the reading increases from 4 to 5.
2. Explain why the first coordinate stays constant.
